purpose.statement: make the edit canvas render the same component truth as the published reader.
purpose.why: The larger goal is PortableDoc content-first editor — make the document itself the complete, parity-true authoring surface. The concrete problem is that component blocks previously had a richer reader path than their editing representation. Reusing the reader renderer in canvas node views and enforcing byte-level parity is why “M3 · 100% render parity — the edit canvas IS the frontend” exists inside that larger goal. If omitted, authors edit a misleading approximation and only discover layout or data loss after publication.
